title: Placements table
description: model.placements.json written by tools/export_glb.py when the whole-model GLB has its own origin per product (--pivots placement or footprint; format placements/1): for each node the product it stands for, where its origin is in the IFC frame, how it is turned, which mesh it draws and whether that mesh is shared with an earlier node. Coordinates are metres in the IFC frame (Z up).

pivot.description: where the origin comes from: the IFC placement, the footprint centre at the lowest point (also the fallback for a placement that is not a proper rotation), a pivot file, or (terrain) the model origin

rotationZDegrees.description: turn of the NODE about the vertical axis, in degrees: the yaw of a placement pivot whose placement is upright, 0 for a node without rotation (footprint, override, terrain); null when the node's rotation is not a turn about the vertical (a tilted or inverted placement), which only the node's quaternion in the GLB describes

instanceOf.description: name of the first node that uses this mesh, null for that node itself

placementIfc.description: the 4 x 4 placement of the product in the IFC file, row by row; it is the node's transform only for pivot placement. For footprint and override nodes the geometry is already turned into world orientation, so this is the product's placement and not the node's; null for terrain (pivot world)
